title: Execution Lab
hook: Candle by candle, from the higher-timeframe story to the decision.

launchpad.outcome: Read the context, mark every step of the sequence as it prints, and make the right entry or no-trade decision.

takeaways: Don’t enter just because BOS #1 or BOS #2 occurred.
Mark the zone from Correction #2, then wait for BOS #3 to activate it.
No retest means no trade. Don’t chase.
An invalidated zone is not an entry opportunity, even if price comes back.

slides.headline: Trade the sequence, not the feeling.
slides.line: Six scenarios. Some are entries. Some are not.
